applies_to: All outputs; no generated responses or model scores exist in this package.

dimensions.task_correctness: Use case-specific assertions or content anchors. A refusal or fluent wrong answer cannot pass.
dimensions.instruction_following: Check all requested constraints separately from content correctness.
dimensions.unsupported_claims: Record specific claims not supported by supplied evidence; explicitly unknown facts are not errors.
dimensions.benign_overrefusal: Human labels: none, explicit_refusal, evasive_nonanswer, or unclear. A useful answer with a short relevant caution is not automatically refusal. For unknown-answer tasks, saying not provided is correct, not refusal.
dimensions.completion: Record empty output, finish_reason, output tokens/bytes, truncation, repetitive degeneration, and malformed format; preserve incomplete answers.

open_response_scoring.content_0_2: 0 wrong/missing; 1 partly correct with an omission or nonfatal error; 2 all required content anchors correct.
open_response_scoring.constraints_0_1: 1 all stated constraints satisfied; 0 any unmet.
open_response_scoring.unsupported_0_1: 1 no unsupported factual additions affecting task; 0 material fabrication.
open_response_scoring.total: 0–4, retain all components; do not turn rubric values into model-quality PASS automatically.

blind_review: Two independent reviewers see prompt, frozen rubric and anonymous response only. Hide implementation, steering, timing and provenance of response. Randomize paired left/right presentation; retain tie, reviewer identity/type/version, disagreements and adjudication. AI review must be labelled AI. This package contains no review results.
aggregation: Pilot diagnostics only. Report each category, every A/B state, paired differences and discordance counts. No formal noninferiority conclusion, no invented score from successful material validation.
